[ndma_heatwave_01] ## Do's During Extreme Heat
- Drink sufficient water and stay hydrated even if not thirsty. Carry drinking water when traveling.
- Use Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS), homemade drinks like lassi, torani (rice water), lemon water, and buttermilk to stay hydrated.
- Wear lightweight, light-coloured, loose, and porous cotton clothes. Cover your head using a cloth, hat, or umbrella.
- Keep animals in shade and provide them plenty of drinking water.
- If you feel faint, dizzy, or ill, see a doctor immediately or use a damp cloth on your head and neck.
- In case of heat stroke, call emergency helpline 112 or disaster helpline 1077.
- Key terms: लू, भीषण गर्मी, उष्माघात, बचाव के उपाय, پانی, వడదెబ్బ, வெப்ப அலை, ତାପ ପ୍ରବାହ, dehydration, ORS, shade, water.

[ndma_coldwave_01] ## Do's During Cold Wave
- Wear multiple layers of loose-fitting, lightweight, warm clothing rather than one thick layer.
- Keep your head, neck, hands, and feet covered warmly with caps, mufflers, gloves, and woolen socks, as significant heat loss occurs from extremities.
- Eat nutritious food rich in vitamin C and warm nutritious soups to maintain body heat and immunity.
- Maintain adequate ventilation when using room heaters, coal stoves, or charcoal angithi to prevent dangerous carbon monoxide buildup.
- Provide warm shelter, dry bedding, and clean water to pets and farm animals.
- Key terms: ठंड, शीतलहर, कडाक्याची थंडी, শৈত্যপ্রবাহ, చలి తీవ్రत, குளிர்காலம், ଶୀତ ଲହରୀ, अंगीठी, कोयला चूल्हा, heaters, carbon monoxide, layers, warm clothes.

[flood_cyclone_safety_02] ## Lightning and Thunderstorm Precautions
- Follow the 30-30 lightning safety rule: If the time between seeing lightning and hearing thunder is less than 30 seconds, seek shelter inside a sturdy building or closed metal vehicle immediately.
- Never take shelter under tall isolated trees, open metal sheds, tin roofs, or flagpoles during thunderstorms.
- If caught in an open field with no shelter nearby, crouch low on the balls of your feet with hands on knees and head tucked down; minimize contact with the ground. Do not lie flat on the ground.
- Discontinue mobile phone charging and unplug high-voltage electrical equipment during severe thunderstorms.
- National Emergency Helpline: 112. Disaster Management Control Room: 1077.
- Key terms: आकाशीय बिजली, तड़ित, विजा, বজ্রপাত, పిడుగుపాటు, இடி மின்னல், ବଜ୍ରପାତ, 30-30 rule, lightning, thunder, crouch, trees.
